title: Acute monoarthritis: gout or sepsis?
stem: Cubicle 30. Mr Siu, 58, woke with an extremely painful, red, swollen right big toe. He had a similar episode a year ago in the same toe. Temperature 37.6 °C. Take a history, examine the joint, and explain management.

phases.title: History
phases.goal: Gout or sepsis? The story and the triggers.

phases.title: Explain
phases.goal: What it is, the treatment, and prevention.

notes:
Checked against EULAR 2016 gout recommendations, the BSR 2017 gout guideline, and NICE NG219 (Gout, 2022).

Acute gout: rapid onset (maximal within 24 hours), first MTP joint (podagra), triggers (alcohol, especially beer and spirits; purine-rich food; dehydration; diuretics; acute illness), recurrent episodes, tophi. Septic arthritis must be excluded when there is fever, systemic illness, or an atypical or prosthetic joint — aspirate. Diagnosis: joint aspiration with negatively birefringent needle-shaped crystals (gold standard); serum urate may be normal during an attack.

Treat the flare: NSAID (with PPI) or colchicine 500 microgram two to four times daily (low-dose regimen) or oral prednisolone 30–35 mg for 3–5 days; ice, rest. Do not stop allopurinol during a flare if already taking it; urate-lowering therapy is offered after the flare (NICE NG219 offers it to people with recurrent flares; treat-to-target urate under 360 µmol/L, or 300 with tophi), with colchicine prophylaxis. Review cardiovascular risk and diuretics.

Your notes list polyarthritis and joint pain topics; nothing conflicts.

steps.label: History
steps.hint: Onset, joints, previous attacks, triggers, systemic symptoms, drugs, renal function, alcohol.

Joint.t: When did it start and how fast?
Joint.tz: 幾時開始痛？係咪好快就好痛？
Joint.rz: 凌晨三點痛醒。幾個鐘內痛到前所未有咁痛，連被單掂到都頂唔順。
Joint.r: Woke at 3 a.m. with it. Worst pain ever within hours; can't bear the bedsheet.

Joint.tz: 其他關節有冇痛？有冇撞傷過？
Joint.mark: Asks about other joints and trauma

Joint.tz: 有冇發燒、發冷震，或者成個人唔舒服？

Triggers.tz: 最近有冇飲酒、食咗啲咩，或者有冇病過？
Triggers.rz: 琴晚食海鮮宴，又飲咗啤酒。
Triggers.r: Seafood banquet and beer last night.

Triggers.tz: 你食緊咩藥？特別係有冇食去水丸？
Triggers.rz: 有，食緊 bendroflumethiazide 降血壓。

Triggers.tz: 有冇腎病、糖尿病或者心臟病？
Triggers.rz: 家庭醫生話我腎功能有少少邊緣。
Triggers.r: Borderline kidney function, per my GP.

steps.label: Examine
steps.hint: The joint, other joints, tophi, skin.

Joint.r: Red, hot, swollen, exquisitely tender; shiny skin.
A small chalky nodule on the right ear helix.

steps.label: Explain
steps.hint: Likely gout; treat the flare; triggers; long-term urate lowering; when to return.

opts.t: This looks like gout — uric acid crystals in the joint. If you had a high fever or felt very unwell, we'd take fluid from the joint to exclude infection.
opts.tz: 睇落係痛風，即係尿酸結晶積咗喺關節入面。如果你發高燒或者好唔舒服，我哋就要抽關節液驗吓，排除細菌感染。
opts.mark: Explains gout and when to exclude sepsis

opts.t: Naproxen with omeprazole (or colchicine 500 microgram 2–4 times a day, or prednisolone if NSAIDs unsuitable); rest and ice
opts.tz: 我會開消炎止痛藥 naproxen，加埋胃藥 omeprazole；如果唔啱食，可以用 colchicine 或者類固醇。休息同埋冰敷。

opts.t: Reduce beer and seafood; ask your GP about changing the water tablet and starting urate-lowering treatment after the attack
opts.tz: 少飲啤酒、少食海鮮。發作過咗之後，同家庭醫生傾吓換降血壓藥，同埋開始食降尿酸藥。
opts.mark: Addresses triggers, diuretics and long-term urate lowering

opts.t: Start allopurinol today at a high dose to stop this attack
opts.tz: 我今日就開高劑量 allopurinol 俾你，止住今次發作。
opts.r: Allopurinol doesn't treat the flare; start after it settles, with prophylaxis.

qs.a: Negatively birefringent needles in joint fluid
wrong: A raised CRP with a hot joint

qs.q: Serum urate during an acute attack is…

wrong: No target; adjust the dose to symptoms alone

badge.name: Podagra
badge.flavor: Hot toe at 3 a.m.: treat the flare, then lower the urate.

options: The hip joint in young women
Lumbar facet joints of the lower spine

cards.q: Low-dose colchicine regimen for acute gout?
options: 1 mg every hour until diarrhoea occurs
10 mg once, as a single loading dose

cards.q: Is allopurinol stopped during a flare if already taken?
options: Yes, always, until the flare settles
cards.why: Stopping and restarting causes further flares.

options: A thiazide diuretic to protect the kidney
No cover is needed if the flare has settled

cards.q: Hot swollen joint with fever and a prosthesis: first think…

options: Urate crystals found in the urine
